content.rendered:
JACK & JONES Jacket  Ethan Sleeveless Puffer is a must-have addition to every modern man’s winter wardrobe. Designed for comfort, style, and practicality, this men’s sleeveless puffer jacket delivers lightweight insulation with a sleek, urban finish. Whether you’re heading outdoors, layering for the season, or simply elevating your casual style, this JACK & JONES jacket blends fashion with functionality effortlessly.

The Ethan sleeveless puffer jacket is a 100% Nylon fit cubed with extra layers to keep you warm. Made with A-Grade fabric to ensure breathability. with the best combination of the materials.

Premium Comfort and Warmth :- Made with high-quality fabric, the JACK & JONES Ethan Sleeveless Jacket ensures optimal warmth without added bulk. Its quilted design retains heat efficiently while keeping you mobile and comfortable. Perfect for pairing over hoodies or full-sleeve tees, it’s ideal for both travel and everyday wear during the chilly months.
Stylish, Versatile DesignThis sleeveless puffer jacket for men stands out with its contemporary cut, zip-up front, and functional side pockets. The minimal yet refined design makes it suitable for multiple occasions — from casual outings to weekend adventures. The Jacket with logo is more than just a layer; it’s a statement piece for modern winter dressing.Why Choose JACK & JONES?

Known globally for their premium apparel, JACK & JONES brings European craftsmanship and timeless streetwear appeal to every product. This lightweight men’s puffer is no exception — durable, stylish, and designed for men who value comfort and confidence.

Key Features:

  • Durable, lightweight polyester shell
  • Warm, sleeveless design perfect for layering
  • Secure zip closure with side pockets
  • Comfortable fit for everyday wear
  • Signature JACK & JONES branding
